visual_prompt: Square 1:1 ad on a deep near-black canvas (#111111) with a premium neon-glow look in lemon yellow (#F2DC4A) and metallic gold (#C9A441, highlights #E6CF7A). Layout in three stacked bands. TOP BAND: at top center a short handwritten white neon script line; directly below it a giant, extra-bold, uppercase geometric sans headline in glowing lemon-gold that spans almost the full width on one line. MIDDLE BAND: three glowing gold thin-line outline silhouettes (line art only, no fill, soft golden bloom) of the same young woman with a ponytail, all in side profile facing right, same height, same slim athletic body proportions in all three, evenly spaced in three columns. Left silhouette: she stands holding a small dropper bottle in one hand and lifts the dropper toward her mouth. Center silhouette: she sits at a small table eating with a spoon from a full bowl. Right silhouette: she performs a squat holding a dumbbell at her chest. Two short dashed gold arrows point right between the silhouettes. Centered under each silhouette, a short white bold italic label. A thin gold horizontal line runs across the canvas below the labels. BOTTOM BAND: at bottom left stands the product, front view at eye level, with a warm golden glow pooled under it and a faint reflection on a glossy black floor. The product is a 60 ml (2 fl oz) amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, topped with a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper; the glass pipette is visible inside the amber liquid. A wraparound label covers most of the body with a smooth vertical gradient from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom. On the label, from top to bottom: the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark line 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows (A, MA, L on the first row; F, BR on the second) with tiny captions, and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)' at the bottom. The bottle is roughly 2.6 times taller than wide including the dropper. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. At bottom right, a wide rounded rectangle with a glowing thin gold border on black: at its top a small outlined pill label with bold uppercase gold text; below it a giant heavy gold figure-and-word with a small stacked two-word line at its right; a thin gold divider; and a final bold uppercase gold line with a small gold outline water-drop icon at its right end. The three silhouettes show actions only: the body shape and size are exactly the same in all three, with no enlargement or emphasis of any body part. No price, no discount, no gift, no CTA button, no logos outside the product label, no stars, no extra text.
